title: IMF总裁谈全球经济前景：韧性犹存但不确定性成常态
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We want to talk a little bit about the global world order, whether we're taking it for granted.
segments.zh: 我们想聊聊全球秩序，是否被我们视为理所当然。

segments.en: I mean, we think about a lot of the short-term risks that have arisen as of late that now seem to become a more structural risk
segments.zh: 近期许多短期风险，如今似乎正演变为更结构性的风险。

segments.en: and earlier this year. You told the world to think the unthinkable.
segments.zh: 今年早些时候，你曾呼吁世界思考不可想象之事。

segments.en: Where do we stand right now? Are governments thinking hard enough?
segments.zh: 目前我们处于什么位置？各国政府思考得够深入吗？

segments.en: Well, what we stand is, one, the world economy has proven to be more resilient than many feared.
segments.zh: 我们的立场是：第一，世界经济比许多人担心的更具韧性。

segments.en: Two, the forces that define where it is headed remain strong and pushing in opposite directions.
segments.zh: 第二，决定其走向的力量依然强劲，且方向相反。

segments.en: We have a negative energy supply shock.
segments.zh: 我们面临负面的能源供给冲击。

segments.en: It is holding us back and we have a positive AI investment demand shock that is lifting the economy up.
segments.zh: 它拖累我们，而积极的AI需求冲击则提振经济。

segments.en: Three, what we have seen is remarkable action when necessary and that is what I am more optimistic about.
segments.zh: 第三，我们看到必要时采取了显著行动，这让我更乐观。

segments.en: We have seen emerging markets developing economies over the last decades building strong institutions, including in the Gulf.
segments.zh: 过去几十年，新兴市场和发展中经济体建立了强大机构，包括海湾地区。
